items.title: The follow-up email was not sent
items.reason_text: The mail step (the part that sends the email) refused the email. If you are not sure, check the mail step before you retry.

items.title: Follow-up did not finish
items.reason_text: The follow-up did not finish and the desk has no confirmation. The email may have left. Check the mail step (the part that sends the email) first. If the email was already sent, Retry sends a second one; Retry is safe only when the mail step remembers which emails it has already sent.

items.title: Follow-up failed; a person marked the email as not sent
items.reason_text: A person checked and marked that the email was not sent. Retry sends it now. If you are not sure it was not sent, check the mail step first.

items.title: The email may or may not have been sent
items.reason_text: An earlier attempt may already have sent the email before a stop. The desk will not send again until a person checks.

confirm.title: Mark the email as sent?
confirm.body: This cannot be undone. The desk will never send this follow-up again.

actions.label: I checked: it was not sent

confirm.title: Mark the email as not sent?
confirm.body: If the email was already sent, a retry will send a second one. Check the mail step first.

items.hint: The CRM may or may not hold this lead. Look in the CRM, then answer crm_present (the row is there: Retry goes straight to the email) or not_sent (the row is not there: Retry asks the CRM again). sent is refused here: no email was ever tried. not_sent: an extra CRM row may need deleting by hand.
items.title: The CRM may or may not have this lead
items.reason_text: The CRM may or may not hold this lead.

confirm.title: Confirm the CRM entry is there?
confirm.body: Retry will then go straight to the email.

actions.label: The CRM entry is not there

confirm.title: Mark the CRM entry as missing?
confirm.body: Retry will ask the CRM again; if a row was there, delete the extra one by hand.

items.title: Incomplete request: email is missing
items.reason_text: Send a corrected submission with a new request number.

items.hint: The desk itself could not decide this receipt (a fault on the desk side, not in the request). A person must look at the desk log. Sending a new request number is not the fix.
items.title: The desk could not decide this request
items.reason_text: The desk itself could not decide this receipt (a fault on the desk side, not in the request). A person must look at the desk log. Sending a new request number is not the fix.

items.title: Queued longer than 120 s
items.reason_text: The desk retries by itself; Retry starts it now.

items.title: Sending longer than 120 s
items.reason_text: The desk puts it back by itself after the send timeout.

items.title: Request received, no verdict for longer than 120 s
items.reason_text: Send the same request number again, or restart the desk.

items.title: The same request came again with different details. The first one stands.
